# 支持只从被支持者获得：越过阈值需要所需条件的升降或要求的改变；在平衡、只有活跃者给予、活动需要支持之下，每次上升由被支持者给予；没有来自外部的给予时，终结是吸收态 / Support is gained only from the supported: crossing a threshold needs a required condition to rise or fall, or a requirement to change; under balance, only active formations giving and activity needing support, every rise is given by a supported formation; with nothing given from beyond, the end absorbs

## 主张 Claim

一个形成在从 t 起的一步上获得支持（Web.GainsSupport），是指它在 t 不被支持、在 t+1 被支持；失去支持（Web.LosesSupport）反之。它的要求在该步上不放松（Web.Unloosened），是指它在 t 的每项要求在 t+1 仍在、所需不降低；不收紧（Web.Untightened），是指它在 t+1 的每项要求在 t 已有、所需不升高。要求不放松时，获得支持只因它所需的某个条件上升（Web.GainsSupport.rises）；要求不收紧时，失去支持只因它所需的某个条件下降（Web.LosesSupport.falls）。在平衡的流中，只有活跃者给予（Acting）且活动需要支持（Dependent）时，每次上升都由参与该步的一个被支持的形成给予（Flow.rise_given_by_supported）；所以要求不放松的形成，只在参与该步的一个被支持的形成向它所需的条件给予时获得支持（Flow.gains_from_supported）。在同样的前提下，一个家族在 T 没有被支持的成员，从 T 起成员的要求都不放松，并且只有成员向成员所需的条件给予时，此后没有成员再被支持（Flow.unsupported_stays）；对整体，一旦什么都不被支持，在要求不放松时，此后什么都不再被支持或活跃（Flow.nothing_supported_stays）。每项前提都必要，各有一个见证（Restoring），其中一个在第零步不被支持的形成在第一步被支持：要求消解（Adapting，要求放松）；家族之外的给予（Inflow，一个不需要任何东西的给予者向所需的条件给予）；不活跃的给予者（Idle，Acting 不成立）；不被支持的活跃给予者（Carried，Dependent 不成立）；没有给予的上升（Spontaneous，平衡不成立）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / A formation gains support across the step from t (Web.GainsSupport) when it is not supported at t and is supported at t+1; it loses support (Web.LosesSupport) in the converse case. Its requirements do not loosen across the step (Web.Unloosened) when each requirement it has at t it still has at t+1, at no lower need; they do not tighten (Web.Untightened) when each requirement it has at t+1 it had at t, at no greater need. Where its requirements do not loosen, it gains support only if a condition it requires rises (Web.GainsSupport.rises); where they do not tighten, it loses support only if a condition it requires falls (Web.LosesSupport.falls). In a balanced flow where only active formations give (Acting) and activity needs support (Dependent), every rise is given by a supported formation taking part in the step (Flow.rise_given_by_supported); so a formation whose requirements do not loosen gains support only where a supported formation taking part gives to a condition it requires (Flow.gains_from_supported). Under the same premises, if no member of a family is supported at T, the members' requirements do not loosen from T on, and only members give to what members require, then no member is supported at any later step (Flow.unsupported_stays); of the whole, once nothing is supported, while requirements do not loosen, nothing is supported or active again (Flow.nothing_supported_stays). Each premise is needed, with a witness for each (Restoring) in which a formation unsupported at step zero is supported at step one: a requirement dissolves (Adapting, requirements loosen); something beyond the family gives (Inflow, a giver requiring nothing gives to the required condition); a giver is not active (Idle, Acting fails); an active giver is not supported (Carried, Dependent fails); a rise is given by nothing (Spontaneous, balance fails). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Admission.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Admission.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 平衡：条件水平的每次变化都是参与者的取用与给予（Flow.Balances）。 / Balance: every change of a condition's level is what those taking part take and give (Flow.Balances).
- 只有活跃者给予（Flow.Acting）；活动需要支持（Web.Dependent）。 / Only active formations give (Flow.Acting); activity needs support (Web.Dependent).
- 阈值的结论只比较一步，并在一个方向上固定形成的要求：获得时不放松，失去时不收紧。吸收态需要从 T 起要求不放松；对家族还需要只有成员向成员所需的条件给予。 / The threshold results compare one step and fix the formation's requirements in one direction: not loosening for gaining, not tightening for losing. The absorbing end needs requirements not loosening from T on and, for a family, only members giving to what members require.
- 离散的步（从第零步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量。 / Discrete steps, counted from step zero; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.

Ren 写道，生成的是“its existence creates more possibilities of becoming - more future, not less”，并且“it is about if the continuation of becoming continues itself”。作者的读法（AI 论证，待 Ren）：支持只从被支持者获得，读作生成的延续延续自身——没有来自外部的给予时，能形成什么只由已被支持者的给予打开。终结是吸收态，读作退化的不可逆一侧：一个家族一旦没有被支持者，只有消解要求（转化，不是恢复）或来自外部的给予能使它再被支持。对整体没有外部，所以整体一旦什么都不被支持，就不再有什么被支持或活跃；这里的整体是一个网中全部形成，即所表示的整体，按 Ren 确认的第二项读法，实际的整体从不是任何中心对它的模型。Ren 说“not harm”是“a phase transition with a clear boundary”；已有的两个相界结果（excess_bounded、joint_excess_ends，见 own-count-misses-joint-excess）与这里的吸收态，是这一读法下的三个形式。读法与名称都是 AI 的。 / Ren wrote that being generative is that “its existence creates more possibilities of becoming - more future, not less”, and that “it is about if the continuation of becoming continues itself”. The author's reading (an AI argument, pending Ren): support gained only from the supported reads as the continuation of becoming continuing itself, since with nothing given from beyond what can form is opened only by what the supported give. The absorbing end reads as the irreversible side of degeneration: once a family has no supported member, only a dissolved requirement (a transformation, not a recovery) or a give from beyond supports it again. Of the whole nothing is beyond, so once nothing in the whole is supported nothing is supported or active again; the whole here is all the formations of a web, the represented whole, and by Ren's second confirmed reading the actual whole is never any center's model of it. Ren said that “not harm” is “a phase transition with a clear boundary”; the two earlier phase results (excess_bounded and joint_excess_ends, see own-count-misses-joint-excess) and this absorbing end are its three forms under this reading. The reading and the names are the AI's.

对每个世界的确切重述是本记录的 Flow.rise_given_by_supported_at、gains_from_supported_at、unsupported_stays_at、nothing_supported_stays_at（P50），局部条件写在规律之内：只在所用各步、在所需条件上平衡（Flow.BalancesOn），给予这些条件者被支持（Flow.GiversSupported）；Flow.rise_given_by_supported、gains_from_supported、unsupported_stays、nothing_supported_stays是它们的推论；多步的可达与恢复（要求消解后的转化与来自外部的给予的条件）；与 RelationalRenewal 的支持门控定律的实例定理；更新能力与关系丰富的比较。 / The exact restatement for every world is this record's Flow.rise_given_by_supported_at, gains_from_supported_at, unsupported_stays_at, nothing_supported_stays_at (P50), the local condition inside the law: balance at the required conditions across the steps used (Flow.BalancesOn) and their givers supported there (Flow.GiversSupported); Flow.rise_given_by_supported, gains_from_supported, unsupported_stays, nothing_supported_stays are their corollaries; reachability and recovery over several steps (the conditions of transformation by a dissolved requirement and of giving from beyond); an instance theorem to the support-gated law of RelationalRenewal; comparisons of renewal capacity and richness of relations.
